video_title: Jalen Brunson and the Knicks react to Game 3 loss to the Spurs | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Mike Budenholzer
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Budenholzer criticizes the free throw disparity in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: I never thought I'd be in the NBA Finals and see a team get 24 free throw attempts
quotes.quote: I never thought I'd be in the NBA Finals and see a team get 24 free throw attempts in the second half to another team's eight. San Antonio is a great team. It's going to lower our odds big time if we play Game 4 and in the second half they get 24 free throw attempts to our eight.

quotes.speaker: Mike Budenholzer
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Budenholzer discusses missed foul calls on Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson gets the ball off a loose ball rebound and he gets whacked across the arm
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson gets the ball off a loose ball rebound and he gets whacked across the arm and they hit the ball and it goes out of bounds on the baseline there's no foul. There were opportunities for fouls to be called to at least try to even the free throws out.

quotes.speaker: Mike Budenholzer
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Budenholzer highlights defensive failures against Steven Castle
quotes.excerpt: Steven Castle got to the paint at will almost every pick and roll he played
quotes.quote: Steven Castle got to the paint at will almost every pick and roll he played. Not only that, we talked about taking away the vertical threat of Victor Wembanyama. He had probably seven lob dunks because we didn't follow the attention to detail in trying to take that away.

quotes.speaker: Mike Budenholzer
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Budenholzer addresses offensive stagnation and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: Offensively we were about as stagnant as I've seen us all year
quotes.quote: Offensively we were about as stagnant as I've seen us all year, which helped with the 13 turnovers. If you're in the NBA Finals game and you have 13 turnovers to their eight, and on those 13 turnovers they generated 21 points, it's going to be tough.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart on the Spurs' aggressive start
quotes.excerpt: They were down 2-0. You knew they were going to come out with a sense of urgency

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: They were down 2-0. You knew they were going to come out with a sense of urgency and a sense of desperation. We should have started the game off better. We should have started the third quarter off better.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Back to 0-0. We're going to learn tomorrow, watch film, and prepare for the game on Thursday.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson identifies turnovers as the cause of the loss
quotes.excerpt: Turn the ball over, didn't execute, didn't do what got us 13 straight wins in a row
quotes.quote: Turn the ball over, didn't execute, didn't do what got us 13 straight wins in a row. That's how you lose the game. We didn't do what we were doing for 13. We decided to do something different and it ain't going to work.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the fans and team accountability
quotes.excerpt: Of course our fans brought it, they always do. We didn't do our job
quotes.quote: Of course our fans brought it, they always do. We didn't do our job to give them something to cheer for after the game. Nothing has to do with us stepping on that court and executing and being disciplined in our game plan approach.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the disappointment of losing Game 3
quotes.excerpt: You're always disappointed when you lose. You always want to step on that court and win
quotes.quote: You're always disappointed when you lose. You always want to step on that court and win. It's always about being in the present and to be in the position that we were going into halftime, to come out in the third the way we did and to not find a way to win the game obviously is disappointing.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on turnovers and fouls in the second half
quotes.excerpt: We turned the ball over a lot first and foremost, but also we were fouling a lot
quotes.quote: We turned the ball over a lot first and foremost, but also we were fouling a lot. Put them at the line about 30 times, and with our live ball turnovers they got them on transition and they were capitalizing off of those. So we were definitely fouling a lot.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson emphasizes the team's '0-0' mindset
quotes.excerpt: We've consistently talked to each other about everything being 0-0, even now 0-0
quotes.quote: We've consistently talked to each other about everything being 0-0, even now 0-0 and moving on and trying to stay focused. There are going to be a lot of distractions, positive and negative, but most importantly is how we compose ourselves as a team, have make sure we have accountability as a team, and we want to lose moving forward as a team.
